questions.question: When turning quickly to avoid an object in the road, what should you do?

options.text: Turn more than necessary to give extra clearance.
Turn only as much as needed to miss the object.
Steer and speed up at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn only as much as needed to miss the object.
questions.explanation: When turning to avoid an object, turn only as much as needed to clear it. Do not brake while turning.

questions.question: When are most drivers the least alert?
questions.explanation: Drivers are least alert at night due to fatigue and tiredness. This is especially true after midnight.

questions.question: What should you do before going down a hill?
questions.explanation: Before going down a hill, shift to a low gear. Gravity will make your vehicle go faster on the hill.

questions.question: What can happen if you use the parking brake in wet, freezing conditions?

options.text: The brakes may freeze and keep the vehicle from moving.
The brakes may suddenly release by themselves.

questions.correctAnswerText: The brakes may freeze and keep the vehicle from moving.
questions.explanation: In wet weather with temperatures below freezing, the parking brake can freeze. This prevents the vehicle from moving.

questions.question: What is the service air line attached to?
questions.explanation: The service air line carries air controlled by the foot brake or trailer hand brake. It is attached to relay valves, which allow trailer brakes to be applied quickly.

questions.question: What happens if you unlock the pintle hook before pulling the dolly out from under the rear trailer?

options.text: The tow bar may cause injury.

questions.correctAnswerText: The tow bar may cause injury.
questions.explanation: Never unlock the pintle hook while the dolly is still under the rear trailer. The dolly tow bar could fly up and cause serious injury.

questions.question: What happens when a combination vehicle turns a corner?

options.text: The turn should be made as tight as possible.
The front and rear wheels follow different paths.
The rear wheels should run over the curb.
It is acceptable to knock over street signs if they are too close to the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The front and rear wheels follow different paths.
questions.explanation: When turning a corner, the rear wheels follow a different path than the front wheels. This is called off-tracking and is more noticeable on vehicles with trailers.

questions.question: When should mirrors be adjusted?

options.text: When standing next to the vehicle.

questions.explanation: Check mirrors before starting a trip. On vehicles with a trailer, mirrors can only be adjusted correctly when the trailer is straight.

questions.question: What does the trailer air supply control look like?

options.text: It is a square blue knob.
It is a triangular yellow knob.
It is an eight-sided red knob.
It is a circular orange knob.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is an eight-sided red knob.
questions.explanation: The trailer air supply control on newer vehicles is an eight-sided red knob. It controls the tractor protection valve.

questions.question: When should you turn off a retarder for safety?

options.text: When you are carrying a passenger.
When you are carrying a heavy load.

questions.explanation: A retarder helps slow your vehicle and reduces brake use. However, using it on slippery roads can cause wheels to skid. Turn off retarders in wet, snowy, or icy conditions.

questions.question: Before driving in winter, you should check:
questions.explanation: Before winter driving, check your heating and defrosting equipment, coolant and antifreeze levels, wipers and washers, tire tread, tire chains, lights, reflectors, and exhaust system. Clear ice and snow from all windows, mirrors, handholds, steps, deck plates, and radiator shutters. Do not close the winterfront too tightly.

questions.question: Bridges usually:

options.text: Freeze only when the temperature drops well below 32 degrees Fahrenheit.
Freeze after other road surfaces freeze.

questions.explanation: Bridges freeze before the rest of the road. Be especially careful when crossing bridges if the temperature is near freezing.

questions.question: When it is hard for others to see your vehicle, like at dawn or dusk, you can help by:

options.text: Waving an arm out the window.

questions.explanation: When visibility is low, turn on your headlights to low beam. If you have trouble seeing others, they probably have trouble seeing you.

questions.question: Push in the trailer air supply control to:
questions.explanation: Push in the trailer air supply control to send air to the trailer. Pull out the control to stop the air supply and activate the emergency brakes.

questions.question: Improper coupling is:
questions.explanation: Drivers of doubles and triples must be able to couple and uncouple trailers correctly. Improper coupling and uncoupling is extremely dangerous.

questions.question: During a static leakage test, a single vehicle with air brakes can leak a maximum of ____ in one minute.
questions.explanation: On a static leakage test for a single vehicle with air brakes, air loss should not exceed 2 psi in one minute. If air leaks faster than this, do not drive the vehicle. It needs repair.

questions.question: All air tanks must have:
questions.explanation: Air brake system tanks must have drain valves. These drain accumulated oil and water from the tanks. They can be operated manually or automatically.

questions.question: When checking trailers in double and triple combinations, a driver should:
questions.explanation: Check trailers in double and triple combinations by walking around them.

questions.question: If a trailer's spring brakes do not release when you push the tractor air supply control, you should:
questions.explanation: Before starting a trip, make sure all equipment works properly. If the trailer's spring brakes do not release when you push the tractor air supply control, check that the air line connections are properly attached and sealed.

questions.question: In an emergency stop, you should:

options.text: Lock the wheels and skid to a stop.
Stop while keeping your vehicle in a straight line.
Expect your vehicle to slow down faster than normal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop while keeping your vehicle in a straight line.
questions.explanation: In an emergency stop, use either controlled braking or stab braking. Brake in a way that keeps your vehicle straight while still allowing you to turn if needed.
